description:
Hi, 
 This is Raju. I am Recruiter at Randstad Technologies and I am reaching out in regards to your background. I have an exciting opportunity
  *Candidates MUST be able to work on W2 to qualify for this role.* 
 ​ 
 
 
 Job Title: QlikSense Developer/Administrator 
 Duration: 12 Months 
 Location: Irving, TX  
 Job Description: 
QlikSense Developers/Admin are information technology experts responsible for extracting data from various sources, using the QlikSense script editor, managing QlickSense Servers, designing dashboards, and creating various QlickSense solutions for a company's clients.The person is responsible for handling the following day-to-day activities which are essential to deliver metrics on a timely basis and ensuring the validity of the same to satisfy highly demanding business needs. 
 Responsibilities: Created data queries and reports using WellView, Qliksense, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, SSRS, and Excel. Created custom queries/reports designed for quality verification and information sharing.

 Round the clock monitoring of Jobs that are running in production and taking necessary action when there are issues. 

 Implementation of Production Changes during the scheduled days and providing post-production support 

 Performance tuning of dashboards was carried out to limit the response time to well under 5 seconCalculation and defining server sizing for optimal performance of Qliksense dashboards. 

 Worked with Qliksense 9.x, upgrade to 10.x, SQL Server 2008, Excel files, flat files. 

 Handling of adhoc reporting and feed requests from production and ensuring to provide monthly and quarterly feeds to finance and Internal audit teams 

 Checking on any long running production jobs and doing any performance tuning activities to ensure jobs are moving faster. 

 Gathering source system maintenance/downtimes during weekends and informing to business about metrics impact 

 Ensuring on-time delivery of metrics, outbound feeds, etc. 

 Verifying and making sure that Microsoft Analysis services cubes are processed properly and reports are published properly in the reporting environment 

 Working with Database Administrators for any DB related issues 

 Analyzing problems, determining root cause, reporting on problem status, etc., for network and desktop (application hardware and software) issues 

 IR Handling for all data marts – ensuring that all assigned IRs are attended and resolved to customer satisfaction in a timely manner 

 Activities associated with incident analysis, resolution and tracking, problem-related task forces, developing and running of utilities and recoveries 

 Analyzing and performance tuning of daily running jobs in production. Re-design & develop the jobs when there is a better way of getting the things done. 

 Required Skills:  
 Degree with 5+ years of professional experience working in building DataWarehouse Applications 

 5+ years of development experience with a minimum of 4 years in Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence 

 5+ years of strong experience in Analysis, Design, Development, Testing and deployment of ETL jobs 

 4+ years of experience with Microsoft SQL server, Analysis Services(Cubes), Integration Services & reporting services experience 

 3+ years of strong experience using Teradata. 

 3+ years of experience with UNIX shell scripting(Ksh/Csh) 

 Experience in complete life cycle implementation of an Enterprise Data Warehouse 

 Good understanding of Ralph Kimball Data Warehouse methodologies and knowledge on the various data design models like Star schema and Snowflake models 

 Exceptional analytical and problem solving skills. Team player with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of development process 

 2+ years of experience in Production Support and code migration from different environments to Production 

 Desired Skills:  
 Working experience in Telecom Data Warehouse 

 Experience in SharePoint excel services 

 Working experience with Tidal Enterprise Scheduler.

 Please have a look at the below job requirement and reply back to me with your latest word format resume ASAP. Do let me know the best contact number to reach you.  

 Note : If you feel this job description does not suit your profile then kindly let me know your preferred job roles so that I can be in touch with you with similar jobs and you can refer me a suitable person for this job as well. Hope to hear from you soon.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
